'''2009 Coruscant Regionals Joe Pinto DS Tatooine: Watto's Junkyard''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Joe Pinto]] at [[2009 Coruscant Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Watto's Junkyard (Dark)|Cor-D-tatooinewattosjunkyard.gif|label=Tatooine: Watto's Junkyard}}
* '''Deck name:''' 3 heroic guys
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
